name: Tata Electronics Pvt.Ltd
india_angle: Tata Electronics has significant operations in Gujarat, Assam, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka, India, employing over 75,000 people.
summary: Tata Electronics Pvt. Ltd is a greenfield venture of the Tata group focused on semiconductor manufacturing and design services. The company offers integrated solutions in semiconductor assembly, test, and foundry services, aiming to serve global customers with a strong operational presence in India.
